geometry_canonicalization.input: artifacts._world(recorded initial world) validates exactly arena/pose/obstacles/goal, finite numeric values and positive radii; use its float64/Python float values. No native state reconstruction.
geometry_canonicalization.number: Normalize any value numerically equal to0.0 to positive0.0; otherwise preserve exact returned finite binary64 value. Encode every number as Python float.hex() string after normalization. No rounding/tolerance.
geometry_canonicalization.heading: Only initial pose[2]: h=math.fmod(theta,math.tau); if h<0 add math.tau; if h==math.tau set0.0; normalize signed zero afterward. Exact binary64 modulo rule, no tolerance; not approximate or rotational-equivalence qualification.
geometry_canonicalization.obstacle_order: Sort normalized numeric obstacle(x,y,r) triples lexicographically; preserve multiplicity. Serialize their float.hex strings in that order.
geometry_canonicalization.digest: SHA256 of UTF8 json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True,separators=(',', ':'),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False), no trailing newline; separate layout/full_scene digests. Seed/run/controller/provenance fields not included.
geometry_canonicalization.refusal: Either layout OR full_scene equality rejects new-to-any-old and distinct-new-scene equality. Same new scene is allowed only across exactly the declared learner seeds10/11/12, requiring both digests and existing full scientific initial fingerprint equality. Preserve old same-split sources; reject oldtrain vs olddev equality in either digest. Cross-arm shared old sources are intentional, not split contamination.
